sections.heading: Kukreja Hotel vs Swami Rama Himalayan University for Hotel Management PG: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Kukreja Institute if a Master of Hotel Management and Catering Technology is the degree you want, with recorded year tuition of ₹1.25 lakh, after you confirm the official notice.

Choose Swami Rama Himalayan University only if Master of Hospital Management is the course you actually want, with recorded year tuition of ₹1,21,250. Do not treat this page as a like-for-like hotel-management comparison.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Kukreja Institute we hold year tuition of ₹1.25 lakh for Master of Hotel Management and Catering Technology. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official programme total.
For Swami Rama Himalayan University we hold year tuition of ₹1,21,250 for Master of Hospital Management.
Confirm the current notices on the official Kukreja and srhu.edu.in pages before you budget. The two degrees serve different careers.

Pick Swami Rama Himalayan University only if hospital management is the degree you want, after official fee confirmation.
